question: The lead chromate which is toxic and carcinogenic, is used for the adulteration of _________ powder.
solution:
The correct answer is __**turmeric.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Lead and chromium** are the two elements that make up** lead chromate.**
 
• It is a** yellow pigment** that can increase a **substance's brightness.**
 
• It is also **dangerous **and, when** consumed or inhaled** by people, acts as a **neurotoxin.**
 
• It** causes cognitive flaws.**
 
• Typically, lead chromate is used by manufacturers to **provide yellow and orange color** to **oils and paints.**
 
• **Turmeric** has been linked to **lead exposure **in numerous** Bangladeshi districts **where it is grown, according to study.
 
• Lead damages **children's neurodevelopment **and exposes **both adults and children **to heart and **brain diseases.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Food adulteration** refers to the practice of** lowering the quality of food** products by either

 
 
• introducing **hazardous substances** into them or
 
• removing** beneficial components** from them.
 
 
 
• **Sugar, glucose, and sugar syrup** are common adulterants in **honey.**
 
• **Vegetable oil, starch, and vanaspati** are frequently found as adulterants in **ghee.**
 
• **Brick powder and artificial colours** are frequent adulterants in** red chilli powder.**
 
• In **pulses, artificial colours** are frequently used as adulterants.
 
• **Pebble, broken grains and polish** are typical adulterants in **rice.**
 
• **Wax coating** is a typical **apple** adulterant.
 
• **Salt** is frequently contaminated with **chalk powder.**
